name: operaton-migration
description: Starter pack for migrating Spring Boot applications with an embedded Camunda 7 engine to Operaton 2.x: Camunda 7.24 EE on Spring Boot 4 in one recipe run (Spring Boot 3.5 via two hops). Assessment, OpenRewrite recipes, leftover and Camunda EE fixes, admin-group and database scripts, cut-over runbook and verification. Skill written for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot agents.
